paragraphs.en: Alkoxycarbonyloxy, cycloalkoxycarbonyloxy, alkoxycarbonylamino, formyl, halogen, haloalkyl, haloalkenyl, haloalkynyl, haloalkoxy, haloalkenyloxy, haloalkynyloxy, haloalkylthio, haloalkenylthio, haloalkynylthio, haloalkylamino, haloalkenylamino, haloalkynylamino, haloalkylsulfonyl, haloalkenylsulfonyl, haloalkynylsulfonyl, haloalkylsulfinyl, haloalkenylsulfinyl, haloalkynylsulfinyl, haloalkylcarbonyl, haloalkoxycarbonyl, haloalkenyloxycarbonyl, haloalkynyloxycarbonyl, haloalkylaminocarbonyl, cyano, nitro,
paragraphs.notes: Unmarked continuation of a substituent list begun on the preceding page; the page opens mid-list with no radical symbol of its own, and the list breaks off at 'Nitro,' with a comma and no closing word before the R5 entry that follows. The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication and not Chinese. A small stray ink blob sits just under the 'alk' of 'Halogenalkenylthio' on the third printed line; it is a scan artifact, not a character.
Superscript 5 on R, rendered inline because the transcription is plain text. Printed with no closing punctuation at all, unlike the neighbouring entries which end in a semicolon.
Superscripts 6 and 12 on R are printed as superscripts; the 1 and 6 in C1-C6 are printed as subscripts.

paragraphs.zh: R7    Wasserstoff, C1-C6-Alkyl, C3-C6-Cycloalkyl, C1-C6-Alkoxy, C1-C6-Alkylthio oder Phenyl;
paragraphs.en: R7    hydrogen, C1-C6-alkyl, C3-C6-cycloalkyl, C1-C6-alkoxy, C1-C6-alkylthio or phenyl;
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 7 on R; the carbon counts in C1-C6 and C3-C6 are printed as subscripts.

paragraphs.zh: R8 und R9    unabhängig voneinander C1-C6-Alkyl, C2-C6-Alkenyl, C2-C6-Alkinyl, Halogen-C1-C6-alkyl, Aryl oder Benzyl;
paragraphs.en: R8 and R9    independently of one another C1-C6-alkyl, C2-C6-alkenyl, C2-C6-alkynyl, halo-C1-C6-alkyl, aryl or benzyl;
paragraphs.notes: Superscripts 8 and 9 on R; carbon counts printed as subscripts. Note the printed case difference between 'C1-C6-Alkyl' and 'Halogen-C1-C6-alkyl', which is reproduced as printed.

paragraphs.zh: R12    Wasserstoff, Halogen-C1-C6-alkyl, C1-C6-Alkylcarbonyl, C1-C6-Alkoxycarbonyl, C1-C6-Alkylsulfonyl, Benzoyl oder Phenylsulfonyl, wobei die beiden letztgenannten Gruppen gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe C1-C6-Alkyl, Halogen-C1-C6-alkyl, C1-C6-Alkoxy, Halogen-C1-C6-alkoxy, Halogen, Cyano und Nitro substituiert sind;
paragraphs.en: R12    hydrogen, halo-C1-C6-alkyl, C1-C6-alkylcarbonyl, C1-C6-alkoxycarbonyl, C1-C6-alkylsulfonyl, benzoyl or phenylsulfonyl, where the two last-named groups are optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of C1-C6-alkyl, halo-C1-C6-alkyl, C1-C6-alkoxy, halo-C1-C6-alkoxy, halogen, cyano and nitro;
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 12 on R; carbon counts printed as subscripts. 'die beiden letztgenannten Gruppen' refers to Benzoyl and Phenylsulfonyl.

paragraphs.zh: L    eine gegebenenfalls durch ein bis 4 gleiche oder verschiedene Reste R2 substituierte C1-C3-Alkylenkette und
paragraphs.en: L    a C1-C3-alkylene chain optionally substituted by one to 4 identical or different radicals R2, and
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 2 on R; the 1 and 3 in C1-C3 are printed as subscripts. A small stray hyphen-like mark sits between the 'L' and the definition text; it is a scan artifact, not printed punctuation. 'ein bis 4' mixes a spelled-out word and a digit exactly as printed.

paragraphs.zh: Y    eine divalente Einheit aus der Gruppe N-Alkyl, CHR7 oder C(R7)2, und
paragraphs.en: Y    a divalent unit from the group consisting of N-alkyl, CHR7 or C(R7)2, and
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 7 on R in both CHR7 and C(R7)2; the 2 after the closing bracket is printed as a subscript.

paragraphs.zh: Z    eine direkte Bindung, eine divalente Einheit aus der Gruppe CHR7 oder C(R7)2 bedeuten.
paragraphs.en: Z    a direct bond, a divalent unit from the group consisting of CHR7 or C(R7)2.
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 7 on R; the 2 after the closing bracket is a subscript. 'bedeuten' closes the whole definition list that began several pages earlier ('worin ... bedeuten' = 'in which ... are'), so it belongs to the list as a whole rather than to Z alone; the English renders it that way.
